description: The tier-one input editors of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5 on the shared editor contract: SvTextInput with a clear button, SvTextArea with auto-grow and a character counter against maxlength, SvOtpInput as a segmented code field that distributes a pasted code and fires onComplete, SvDurationInput converting text such as 1h 30m to minutes, and SvMultiSelect as a portalled checkbox dropdown with search and chips capped by maxTagCount. Each is standalone and a grid cell editor.

faq.question: How does the OTP input handle paste?
faq.answer: Pasting a full code into any box distributes the characters across the segments and fires onComplete with the value; typing moves focus forward and Backspace moves it back.

faq.question: What does SvDurationInput store?
faq.answer: A number of minutes. The units style accepts and displays text such as 1h 30m, so users type naturally while your state holds an integer.

faq.question: How does the multi-select show many values?
faq.answer: Selected options render as chips; maxTagCount limits how many are shown before a +N summary, and the dropdown keeps checkboxes with a search box.
